cards.card_text: The palace builder says, "I will build myself a great palace, with spacious upper rooms." So he cuts windows, panels it with cedar and paints it with vermilion, the whole showroom.
cards.verse_text: who says, ‘I will build myself a great palace, with spacious upper rooms.’ So he cuts windows in it, panels it with cedar, and paints it with vermilion.
cards.snippet: …cuts windows in it, panels it with cedar, and paints it with vermilion.

cards.card_text: But Oholibah goes further: she sees men engraved on a wall in vermilion, with belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads.
cards.verse_text: She saw the men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion, wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
